subject: Close cadence: MAP handoff, updated risk log and request for exec review
messages:
From: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-10-18T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: MAP review + concern: go-live slide by 10/30?

Marcus —

Quick note after our internal acceptance planning this morning: current MAP milestones assume a go-live window around 10/30, but procurement flagged two items that could push us into November — the primary is the updated data retention addendum and a final security attestation from our auditors. Can you confirm whether the MAP can be tightened or if we need to formally rebaseline?

High-level asks:
- Can Redwood provide an updated risk log showing mitigation steps and owner for each blocker?
- If we need to rebaseline, can you propose a 1- or 2-week alternate timeline?
- Any chance of a small credit if acceptance slips >7 days? (Procurement asked this)

Appreciate a quick turn; leadership wants visibility by COB today.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Lee
Director, Clinical Integrations
Acme Health

Date: 2028-10-18T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP review + concern: go-live slide by 10/30?

Hannah —

Thanks for surfacing this. Short answer: we can produce both a mitigation-focused risk log and two alternate MAP timelines (10/30 baseline, and a 11/13 contingency). Grace will own the risk-log update and the timeline rebaseline; copying Laura for any commercial escalation if procurement needs credits.

Immediate next steps (we'll deliver by EOD):
- Grace: updated risk log with owners and ETA for mitigations (attachment)
- Proposed map adjustments: minimal and conservative variants (attachment)
- Marcus: coordinate with engineering on final security attestation ETA and share with Acme auditors

If procurement needs an early decision on credits, Laura can weigh in.

Marcus Lin
Enterprise Lead, Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP review + concern: go-live slide by 10/30? — risk log + two MAP options attached

Hannah / Marcus —

Attached: acme-risk-log-v2.xlsx (tabbed by blocker), proposed-map-adjustment.pdf (baseline + conservative). Summary below.

Top 5 blockers (with owners & mitigations):
1) Data retention addendum — Owner: Legal (Acme) / Grace (Redwood) — Mitigation: draft addendum v1 to Acme by 10/20; target sign 10/25.
2) Security attestation timeline — Owner: Redwood Security (Grace) — Mitigation: provide auditor-ready package by 10/22; parallel review with Acme auditor during 10/23–10/26.
3) Integration test flakiness (prefix cache) — Owner: Eng (Marcus coordinating) — Mitigation: two-hour dedicated surge for test cycle on 10/21.
4) Procurement approval hold for SOW credit — Owner: Acme Procurement — Mitigation: Laura to propose credit framework if slip >7 days (see credit-request-form.docx).
5) Acceptance script alignment — Owner: Acme PM / Redwood CS — Mitigation: joint runbook review on 10/24.

Proposed timelines:
- Option A (tight): Maintain 10/30 go-live by compressing acceptance window; requires addendum signed by 10/25 and security attestation delivered by 10/22.
- Option B (prudent): Rebaseline to 11/13 with staged cutover; buys two weeks for legal & audit closure and avoids rushed acceptance.

Recommended: present both options to Acme execs and confirm a preferred path by 10/21. If procurement confirms a credit ask, we can fast-track an exec alignment call.

Grace O'Connor
Sr. Program Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- acme-risk-log-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
- proposed-map-adjustment.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@acmehealth.com>

Subject: Re: MAP review + concern: go-live slide by 10/30? — risk log + two MAP options attached

Grace / Marcus —

Thanks for the rapid turn. Procurement reviewed the attachments — the addendum timeline looks doable but the auditor needs the security package earlier than 10/22. They asked whether Redwood can accelerate delivery to 10/19 or, alternatively, sign an acknowledgment that the auditor review window will be officially part of the MAP so we can lock a rebaseline without last-minute slippage.

On the credit item: procurement wants a written commercial proposal if the team votes to rebaseline to 11/13 (they're open to a small credit or invoice deferral). Can Laura or someone in commercial share a short proposal?

I'll schedule a 30-min exec call for Monday 10/22 9:00am ET unless you object.

-Hannah

Hannah —

Forwarding the thread to confirm: Redwood can draft a short commercial proposal tied to the two timeline options. To be transparent, we need a single point of sign-off on the addendum execution timeline to avoid repeated slippage. Proposed commercial options:

- If Acme keeps 10/30 baseline and we meet the accelerated security deliverable (10/19 delivery accepted by auditor), no credit applied.
- If Acme elects Option B (rebaseline to 11/13), Redwood offers a one-time 5% invoice credit applied to the first month of production or an equivalent 30-day invoice deferral (Acme to choose).

I'll put the commercial proposal in DocuSign for signature once we have Acme's selection. Ben, please stand by for any procurement questions.

Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
